job.title: Senior Analytics Engineer I
job.pay_full: $101,000 – $158,000 a year starting pay range (US), with expected on-target earnings of $112,000 – $176,000 a year including bonus or commission, plus RSU equity grants

details.about: Braze is a customer engagement platform that helps brands deliver personalised, cross-channel customer experiences. This role sits in Business Analytics, part of the Data Engineering and Enterprise Platforms division in the Office of the CIO, which turns data from systems across Braze into certified, decision-ready data products for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Partnerships and their operations teams.
duties: Design and build dbt models in Snowflake for sales pipeline, marketing lifecycle, partnerships, professional services and customer success, starting each significant build with a reviewed written design
Make light Looker changes when a model change needs them
Model history with quarter-end snapshots, slowly changing attributes and event time series
Own metric definitions end to end and document what each model measures
Trace lineage and get fixes made with the teams that own other models
Help set development, testing and code review standards; review pull requests and mentor teammates
Turn loose stakeholder questions into precise requests
needs: Typically 6+ years in data roles, with deep hands-on analytics engineering or data modeling and direct work with operations teams at a B2B SaaS company
Expert SQL and modular dbt development in Snowflake: dimensional modeling, snapshots, incremental models, thorough tests and documentation
Understanding of Snowflake performance and cost trade-offs
Model and metric design for grain, history and reuse
Turning ambiguous asks into precise definitions and requirements
Cross-team collaboration and technical leadership (mentoring, careful code review)
Has shipped reusable AI workflows, skills or tools that teammates adopted
Domain knowledge of GTM, post-sale or business operations data in SaaS
Independent delivery of your own projects
nice: Semantic models or certified metric definitions used by AI or conversational analytics (e.g. Snowflake Cortex Analyst or the dbt Semantic Layer)
Working Python for ad-hoc analysis and data quality issues
Data observability or data catalog tools
details.benefits: Starting pay for US-based candidates is expected to be $101,000 – $158,000 a year, with on-target earnings of $112,000 – $176,000 a year including bonus or commission; the exact offer depends on location, knowledge, skills and experience. The role also includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs). Benefits can include retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans, flexible paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life and disability cover, fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave, career pathing with a yearly learning stipend, and volunteer and donation-matching programs. Benefits vary by location.
notes: Braze weighs depth of modeling experience over total years
